answer: Forging one thousand sybil identities costs one thousand stakes plus one thousand independent work solutions, while honest participants amortize a single stake across many epochs. Each agent must stake a scarce on-chain token whose provenance is tracked from a basalt-anchored genesis registry, then solve a per-epoch proof-of-work keyed to its reputation slot. Colluding farms burn jade credits and marble bonds on every fake node, making attacks linearly expensive and unprofitable before they ever reach quorum. In practice, Agent0005 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
